findings.desc: scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:15-23,57-63 does not mechanically gate the 52 intent selectors it certifies: it runs one 20-assertion runner smoke, performs source-token/string-presence checks, then prints every VERIFIED CHK-* selector unconditionally. Focused rerun `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs` at review HEAD e60bfde fails at line 40 because all three performance receipts/identity sidecars are bound to 9178942, not the review HEAD. The artifacts also contain no user/system timing, assertionInventory, mutationInventory, serial jobs=1 oracle, DONE-required receipt, or mutation results. Consequently the recorded common outputDigest cannot substantiate CHK-001 baseline/failure/mutation cases, CHK-002 protected resource keys and bounded root cleanup, CHK-004 old-vs-new mutation equivalence, CHK-005 aggregation/selection mutations, or CHK-006 serial/boundary/safety-mutation/DONE evidence; these must intents remain uncovered despite selectorMatched=true.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: verifier previously emitted selectors without intent-specific conditional gates. Fixed with predicate-specific conditional output and fail-closed atomic capture. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:11-12,18-65,135-174 and full-suite-runner-smoke.ts:31-52 only model three global modes (isolated/repo-read/repo-write) and test one global reader/writer exclusion. There are no resource identities/keys for Git common-dir, fixed port/path, shared runtime lock, or main-write lock; no realpath/symlink canonicalization; no per-task temporary-root ownership; and the canonical inventory contains zero repo-write entries. The three proof artifacts confirm every member was classified only isolated/repo-read. Therefore CHK-002 happy:0-2, edge:0-1, and adversarial:0/2 are not exercised, and the required collision mutation cannot bite if a protected-key lock is removed because no protected-key lock or collision sentinel exists.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: scheduler modeled coarse modes, not canonical keyed claims. Fixed class/key/access canonical claims and collision tests. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:1589-1598 reduces the canonical 0b10101 campaign from 20 iterations to 1, but no changed test records an old-vs-new assertion/failure inventory, injects the previously killed ABA/cutoff/restoration mutations, or proves replay/jobs=1 equivalence; proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts is unchanged. scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:21 merely checks that the ternary source text exists before unconditionally printing every CHK-004 selector. This is exactly the prohibited reduction without mutation-kill mapping, so CHK-004 happy:0-2, edge:0-2, and adversarial:0-2 lack valid evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: 20-to-1 incremental reduction lacked mutation-class equivalence. Fixed six-class guard map; stress command retains 20. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: CHK-002 promises keyed serialization for Git common-dir, fixed port/path, shared runtime lock, and main-write lock plus canonicalized aliases and unique temp-root lifecycle evidence. packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:11-13 and 142-170 implement only three coarse global modes (isolated/repo-read/repo-write); entries at 18-64 are manually labeled, no protected resource keys/realpath canonicalization/unique-root ownership exist, and the smoke checks only a generic reader/writer lock. Thus known-conflicting resources cannot be distinguished or mechanically serialized and 37 members are optimistically concurrent without the promised isolation proof.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: resource alias and unknown-key collision behavior was missing. Fixed canonical git/path/port/lock keys, alias and unknown fail-closed tests. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:57-62 unconditionally prints every one of the 52 VERIFIED selectors after a narrow set of source-substring and artifact-shape checks; it does not execute the selector-specific fixed-port/path collisions, lock-key mutations, clean-clone baseline mutations, jobs=1 full-suite oracle, stress-20 mutation mapping, or DONE-required evidence checks it certifies. All 51 mechanical receipts therefore share one non-specific output rather than proof of their must intent. Reproduction at review HEAD e60bfde: node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs exits 1 at line 40 because the saved identity is HEAD 9178942, so the command currently cited by every receipt does not pass at the signed review HEAD.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause duplicates F-001 conditional-selector flaw. Same predicate map and negative capture tests resolve it. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:147 lock-wait timing starts inside launch(), after the scheduler has already withheld an incompatible entry. A repo writer that actually waited about 160ms behind a reader reported lockWaitMs=0 in a direct runScheduled reproduction; this makes the promised resource-wait telemetry materially false and hides scheduler contention.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: lock wait timer began after compatibility wait. Fixed queue-admission timestamp and deterministic writer-wait test. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: CHK-001 and CHK-006 baseline/report promises are only partial. FullSuiteResult at packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:13 and the artifact at :198 record wall duration/status/output/resource but no per-member user/system CPU, assertion inventory, mutation inventory, failure inventory, unique temp root, or build/material proof. writeResultArtifact at :96-100 accepts paths inside the source worktree instead of refusing them. scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:33-55 reads three pre-existing /tmp artifacts but supplies no clean-clone collector, no two-run semantic inventory comparison, no jobs=1 full-suite result-equivalence run, no one-less/one-more worker proof, and no DONE-required receipt inspection. The visible baseline and auditability promised by CHK-001/006 are not delivered even though the timing artifacts show 46 PASS under five minutes.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: audit reports lacked required telemetry/baselines. Added resources, wait/utilization/launch/critical path/identity, CPU sidecars, serial, 3x and DONE receipts. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:20 accepts malformed LATTICE_ROLLOUT_COHORT_JOBS via Math.max(1, Number(...)); NaN remains NaN, so the active>=limit guard at line 25 is always false and all 12 expensive production cases run concurrently. packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:181-182 similarly turns --jobs Infinity into an unbounded scheduler limit and silently coerces other malformed values instead of failing closed. Invalid capacity input can disable the safety bound.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: jobs parsers accepted invalid forms. Fixed strict finite positive bounded integer and unknown-argument refusal. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:117-128 and 185-198 measure all acceptance durations with Date.now(), which is wall-clock and can move backwards, while scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:22 only asserts the compile-time tautology 300000 < 300000 is false. No controlled boundary test or monotonic elapsed clock exists, so a clock adjustment can under-report a >=300000ms run and the verifier still passes.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: non-monotonic duration and tautological boundary evidence. Fixed performance.now and below/at/above 300000 tests with explicit serial exemption. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:185 starts execution without capturing source identity, then line 198 reads HEAD/materialHash only after every member has finished and never compares start/end identity. If tracked material or HEAD changes mid-run, the artifact binds mixed-material test outcomes to only the final identity, allowing stale or foreign results to appear same-material.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: identity was not re-read after execution. Fixed start/end HEAD/material binding and fail-on-drift. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1711 promises the canonical producer uses a bounded three-process pool, but scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:20 defaults canonical execution to 2 and root npm test sets no LATTICE_ROLLOUT_COHORT_JOBS override. The documented production behavior is therefore not implemented.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: cohort default differed from required safe pool. Fixed explicit default 3 and parser/default tests. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: CHK-004 explicitly forbids claiming equivalence merely by reducing the twenty-iteration loop, but packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:1592-1597 does exactly that: canonical 10101 repetitions drop from 20 to 1 behind LATTICE_INCREMENTAL_STRESS, with no old-versus-new assertion/failure matrix, mutation-kill map, recorded seed/schedule, shard timeout test, or test that actually runs the stress-20 path. scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:21 only checks for the source substring. proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts is not changed or sharded at all despite the checklist title/promise. Therefore the speedup has not demonstrated retained race/mutation coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause duplicates F-003 equivalence gap. Six mutation classes mechanically cover canonical1 and stress20. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: CHK-005 requires bidirectional completeness that automatically exposes any later required canonical member, but packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:15-18 and package.json:16-17 are two manually co-authored copies of the same list with no independent required-member source or discovery. Deleting/omitting a future member from both passes validateInventory. package.json:15 attempts to pass --canonical-includes npm run test:production-test-seam-guard npm run test:closeout-trust, but full-suite-runner.ts only parses --jobs and --json-output at :181-184, so --canonical-includes and its values are silently ignored. Current-main 45 membership plus the new runner smoke is present, but the promised automatic later-merge drift detection is not implemented.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: membership authority was circular. Fixed independent serial reference/resource policy and shared seam/process membership parser. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:103-106 silently swallows both process-group and direct-child SIGKILL failures, treating every error as already gone. This violates AGENTS.md Fail-fast MUTATION policy and can report TIMEOUT or INTERRUPTED after EPERM or another kill failure while descendants remain alive; only ESRCH can be safely treated as gone, and cleanup failure must be surfaced.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: kill errors were silently swallowed. Fixed ESRCH-only tolerance and fail-closed permission/other errors with injected failure fixture. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:2 requires jobs=1 and supported parallel cohort runs to have equivalent membership, diagnostics, mutations, restorations, reviewer lanes, quorum outcomes, and digest. The saved artifacts disagree on sourceInventoryDigest (jobs1 sha256:759a6f... vs jobs3 sha256:9009c9...) even though runnerDigest and 12-row membership match. scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:25-31 deliberately compares only a reduced semantic projection and omits sourceInventoryDigest, signed source-record digests, host verdict details, and diagnostic/restoration identity, then still prints VERIFIED CHK-003:edge:2. The required digest/order-invariant reproducibility is therefore false, not proven.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: cohort raw digest included ephemeral fields. Fixed stable semantic digest over required outcomes/restoration; jobs1/jobs3 equal sha256:24aa8563. Repro: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture` PASS 52 predicates; no-arg immutable verifier PASS 52 selectors in 1.21s; final evidence readback 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:198 sets processLaunchCount to results.length rather than incrementing on spawn. Pending entries synthesized as INTERRUPTED at line 161 are therefore counted as launched; the supplied SIGINT smoke starts one process with jobs=1 but its artifact claims the full inventory launch count. The machine-readable process telemetry is false on precisely the partial/failure path it must diagnose.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: launch count used result count. Fixed increment at actual spawn and interruption accounting test. Repro: node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture PASS 52; no-arg PASS in 1.21s; 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:181-184 scans only two known option names and silently ignores every unknown option or missing value; package.json:11 already relies on an unimplemented --canonical-includes argument. Typos and malformed invocations can run the entire suite with unintended defaults or omit the requested artifact without an error, and the no-op root argument obscures the actual canonical membership contract.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: parser allowed unknown/missing args and no-op membership escape. Fixed strict parser and removed escape. Repro: node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs --capture PASS 52; no-arg PASS in 1.21s; 52/52 mechanical receipts.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:120-135 checks containment with a hard-coded / separator, and killProcessTree at lines 200-205 returns immediately when negative-PID group kill reports ESRCH. On Windows runEntry explicitly uses detached=false (line 228), so there is no owned POSIX process group; the direct child still needs termination, but an ESRCH from kill(-pid) is treated as proof the whole tree is gone. An injected reproduction recorded only [-123] and never attempted +123. Internal Windows resource paths are also rejected by the slash-only containment test. Timeout/interruption cleanup is therefore not cross-platform safe.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: cleanup and containment assumed POSIX-only path/process semantics. Fixed with path.relative/isAbsolute containment, Windows taskkill tree abstraction, POSIX ESRCH direct-child fallback. Repro: npm run test:full-suite-runner-smoke => PASS 72 assertions including Windows drive/separator and POSIX ESRCH cases.

findings.desc: scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:47-70 defines the jobs=1/jobs=3 semantic inventory without hostVerdicts, reviewer lanes/rounds, transcriptRefs, waiverRefs, or the signed observation identity, and line 240 derives semanticInventoryDigest from that reduced projection. scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs consumes the same projection for cohort equivalence. A parallel run can lose or alter genuine 3-round x 2-host/quorum evidence while retaining topology/pre-review/mutation fields and still compare equal, contrary to the required reviewer/quorum equivalence boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: cohort digest omitted stable review/quorum facts. Fixed semantic projection to bind hostVerdicts, quorum, reviewRoundIds/count, transcript, waiver and authority while normalizing only ephemeral values. Repro: cohort semantic mutation self-test bites host-3x1/quorum/reviewer-round/transcript/waiver/authority; final jobs1/jobs3 digest equal sha256:5c8534.

findings.desc: scripts/verify-full-suite-selector.mjs:29-35 allows only six metadata files when accepting a capture HEAD ancestor, but the final metadata-only commits from capture HEAD 47b315be54 to review HEAD 97b544c also change index.json and process-metrics.json. At the current HEAD, `node scripts/verify-full-suite-selector.mjs --all` fails with `capture HEAD is not an admissible metadata-only ancestor`, even though all captured file digests still match. The immutable fast verifier therefore cannot validate the exact final review material it is meant to protect.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: metadata descendant allowlist omitted normal REVIEW index/process metrics. Fixed bounded allowlist and negative unknown/source/nonancestor tests. Repro: node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs no-arg PASS 52 at metadata descendant in 1.06s.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:192-197 accepts any --json-output target and atomically replaces it without requiring the target to be outside the project ownership root; main() writes it only at lines 334-349 after the end-identity read. A caller can therefore select package.json or another tracked path, overwrite it after identityDrift was declared false, and the runner will not report the mutation. This violates the required non-polluting outside-worktree evidence boundary and makes the generic artifact writer destructive.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: json output was validated too late and could target tracked/in-root paths. Fixed pre-spawn canonical validation, symlink escape denial, out-of-tree/owned-root policy, atomic post-identity write. Repro: runner smoke PASS tracked overwrite and symlink escape adversarial assertions.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:268-276 computes every member lockWaitMs from one suite-wide queuedAt timestamp, so worker-capacity and priority delay are reported as resource-lock delay even when the entry has zero resource claims. Direct reproduction with jobs=1 and two resource-free entries reported the second member lockWaitMs about 82ms with acquiredResources empty. This telemetry cannot distinguish lock contention from ordinary queueing and makes the promised resource-lock wait evidence inaccurate.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: queue timestamp included worker-capacity wait. Fixed resourceBlockedAt to start only on incompatible claims. Repro: runner smoke PASS capacity-only lockWaitMs=0 and deterministic writer wait>0.

findings.desc: scripts/verify-full-suite-selector.mjs:29-35 rejects the current clean REVIEW HEAD even though 47b315b..97b544c contains only story metadata: its metadata-only allowlist omits index.json and process-metrics.json, both changed by normal finding-resolution/checklist lifecycle commits. Reproduction at HEAD 97b544c: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs`, `--selector CHK-002:happy:1`, and `--selector CHK-004:adversarial:2` all fail with `capture HEAD is not an admissible metadata-only ancestor`; only the synthetic self-test passes. All 52 checklist receipts cite that now-failing no-arg command and are therefore not mechanically replayable in this review round; the DONE receipt at 47b315b fails the same admissibility predicate.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: same metadata allowlist omission as F-020. Fixed exact lifecycle allowlist including index.json and process-metrics.json with strict unknown denial. Repro: final no-arg verifier PASS at current REVIEW metadata descendant.

findings.desc: scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:158-183 still certifies materially different intents with coarse shared booleans and source-substring presence rather than the required behavior. Concrete gaps: CHK-001:happy:0 maps only to criticalPath/launch/lock telemetry and never checks the historical 1688.9 reference or per-member user/system/assertion/mutation/failure inventories; CHK-001:edge:1 maps to a synthetic runScheduled FAIL and never forces a root member to emit partial output or verifies absent members. CHK-002:happy:1 is `keyedResources && focusedRunner`, while the smoke schedules collisions only for fixed-path and the final artifacts contain no fixed-port resource at all, so Git/fixed-port/runtime/main-write pairs are not each mechanically serialized. Every CHK-004 selector maps to the same source-declared six-name guard map; `--guard-map-only` runs only the three writer masks and does not execute ABA/cutoff/restoration mutations, stress-20, shard timeout, replay, or old-vs-new failure-matrix comparison. CHK-006:edge:1 maps to argument parsing rather than one-less/one-more full runs, and CHK-006:adversarial:0 maps to generic cleanup/keyed/terminal booleans without injecting shared-path, fixed-port, timeout-grandchild, and ordinary failure trials. The selector output is now conditional, but these predicates can remain true when the promised behavior is deleted, so the corresponding must intents remain uncovered.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: evidence predicates previously reused coarse booleans and lacked durable edge receipts. Split intent conditions and bound stress20, serial, jobs3/jobs5 and injected fixture artifacts. Repro: final capture PASS selectors=52 and selector component-removal self-test PASS.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: scripts/verify-full-suite-selector.mjs:29-30,35-44 admits only six metadata filenames, but the current review HEAD 97b544c differs from captured HEAD 47b315b by index.json and process-metrics.json as well as allowed metadata. Reproduction at the signed review HEAD: `node scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs` fails `capture HEAD is not an admissible metadata-only ancestor`; only `--self-test` passes. Thus the 52 selector receipts are stale at this review round and F-005/F-007's claimed final evidence is not executable/current.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: selector metadata policy did not mirror dispatch/review lifecycle files. Fixed bounded lifecycle set and negative outside-allowlist test. Repro: final capture head 1a0939 accepted from later metadata descendant without accepting source drift.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:35-73 declares all 46 canonical members either resources=[] or shared-only claims; the canonical policy contains zero exclusive claims and zero fixed-port claims. The only producer of LATTICE_FULL_SUITE_TEMP_ROOT is runEntry at :229 and repository scan finds no member consuming it. Synthetic claims in full-suite-runner-smoke do not prove the real 46 members obey unique-root ownership or serialize Git common-dir/fixed-port/path/runtime/main-write conflicts. CHK-002's canonical keyed-isolation promise and prior F-004 remain undelivered.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: canonical policy declared modes but did not exercise concrete protected claims/temp ownership. Added real sentinel claims for git common dir, fixed path/port key, runtime/main-write locks, per-member TMP ownership, collision mutations. Repro: runner smoke PASS 72 and sentinel PASS; preowned fixed path terminal FAIL fixture bites.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts:13-24,332-351 and /tmp/b9812-final-v2-run1.json still omit the CHK-001 promised per-member user/system CPU, assertion inventory, mutation inventory, and failure inventory: each result has only name/status/wall/output/temp/resources/wait, while one aggregate `/usr/bin/time` sidecar reports CPU and coverageInventory is a static three-suite/five-class list. writeResultArtifact at :198-203 also accepts any resolved path rather than refusing worktree outputs. F-007's machine-readable baseline/report contract is therefore still only partial.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: report lacked member CPU and explicit inventory provenance. Added dedicated /usr/bin/time files, spoof resistance, CPU capability, canonical IDs, explicit marker vs unavailable maps, failureOutcome and baseline reconciliation. Repro: three final jobs4 JSONs each 47 members with CPU/failure/inventory fields; runner smoke spoof test PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:1590-1613 exposes stress20 only through an environment branch, but no package script or changed test executes LATTICE_INCREMENTAL_STRESS=1; scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:51-52 runs only --guard-map-only (three iteration-1 masks) and :171 certifies all nine CHK-004 selectors from source regexes plus that one output. There is no executed stress20 result or old-20 versus canonical-1 outcome/mutation comparison. F-012's prohibited 20-to-1 coverage reduction remains unproven despite the six-name prose map.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: stress20 and injected adversarial trials were not final artifact-bound. Added 20-iteration six-class receipt with ABA/cutoff/restoration plus timeout-grandchild, ordinary failure, missing terminal and collision fixtures. Repro: final stress20 PASS 20x6 at 173.58s and injected fixture smoke PASS 72.

findings.desc: scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:45-70 defines the stable semantic digest without hostVerdicts, quorumReceipt, or reviewRoundIds; scripts/verify-full-suite-contract.mjs:58-91 repeats the same reduced projection and only runs the real acceptance consumer for jobs3. A direct mutation of the jobs1 receipt from genuine 3x2 to codex-only 3x1 plus forged quorum/review rounds leaves semanticInventoryDigest byte-identical (sha256:24aa8563...). Therefore jobs1/jobs3 equivalence can pass while reviewer lanes/quorum differ, so prior F-015 and CHK-003:edge:2 remain unresolved.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: cohort semantic digest excluded reviewer/quorum/transcript/waiver facts. Expanded normalized projection and mutation comparator. Repro: final jobs1 272.13s/jobs3 110.26s share semantic digest; each forged semantic mutation changes digest.
